name: flin-gtm-mcp
description: Read-only Google Tag Manager: inspect accounts, containers, tags, triggers and versions.

credentials_file.title: Google OAuth credentials JSON
credentials_file.description: Select your Google Cloud Desktop app OAuth JSON (or service-account JSON). Enable Tag Manager API first.

long_description: Read-only Google Tag Manager access. Downloads the newest stable flin-gtm-mcp server from PyPI whenever the extension starts. Updates need internet and take effect after a server/Claude restart. Google credentials and login stay on this Mac.
